_comment: Guards the Invigorate lethal-with-no-own-attacker fire (item 4). Tainted Remedy in play flips Invigorate's alt cost 'opponent gains 3' to -3. We control a Forest (alt-cost subtype) but have NO creature of our own -- the opponent controls the only creature (Skyshroud Cutter), which is Invigorate's legal 'target creature'. With opp at 3 and no ready attacker, the pump is moot but the free alt-cost 3 is exactly lethal. PASS = CanAutoFireAltPayload fires Invigorate targeting the opponent's creature for legality, the executor applies the alt-cost with the pump skipped (lockstep with the rollout), opp -> 0, win T4. Before item 4 the own-attacker requirement refused this and the game did not end.
